proposal.summary: Authenticated path traversal in ArubaOS web management interface allows deletion of arbitrary files on the underlying OS.

C.quote: ability to delete arbitrary files in the underlying operating system.

A.quote: ability to delete arbitrary files in the underlying operating system.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the ArubaOS versions affected and any available vendor fixes or mitigations; reproduce the issue to produce a patch or workaround to prevent traversal and unauthorized file deletions.

evidence_quotes.quote: An authenticated path traversal vulnerability exists in the ArubaOS web-based management interface.
Successful exploitation of this vulnerability results in the ability to delete arbitrary files in the underlying operating system.
